source.documentName: CBSE Secondary School Curriculum 2024-25 - Science (Subject Code 086)

units.title: Unit I: Matter - Its Nature and Behaviour

chapters.title: Matter in Our Surroundings
chapters.description: Definition of matter; solid, liquid and gas; characteristics - shape, volume, density; change of state - melting (absorption of heat), freezing, evaporation (cooling by evaporation), condensation, sublimation.

levels.title: States of Matter & Particle Theory
levels.description: Characteristics of particles of matter, diffusion, and kinetic energy across solids, liquids, and gases.

levels.title: Interconversion of States & Evaporation
levels.description: Latent heat of fusion, latent heat of vaporization, sublimation, and factors affecting evaporation.

chapters.title: Is Matter Around Us Pure?
chapters.description: Elements, compounds and mixtures. Heterogeneous and homogenous mixtures, colloids and suspensions. Physical and chemical changes.

levels.title: Mixtures, Solutions, Colloids & Suspensions
levels.description: Concentration of solutions (mass percentage), Tyndall effect, and Brownian motion.
subtopics: True solution vs colloid vs suspension

chapters.title: Atoms and Molecules
chapters.description: Atoms and molecules, law of chemical combination, chemical formula of common compounds, atomic and molecular masses.

levels.title: Laws of Chemical Combination & Chemical Formulae
levels.description: Law of conservation of mass, law of constant proportions, Dalton's atomic theory, writing chemical formulae using valency criss-cross.

chapters.title: Structure of the Atom
chapters.description: Electrons, protons and neutrons, valency, atomic number and mass number, isotopes and isobars.

levels.title: Subatomic Particles & Atomic Models
levels.description: Thomson model, Rutherford alpha scattering experiment, Bohr model of atom, Bohr-Bury electronic configuration.

units.title: Unit II: Organization in the Living World

chapters.title: The Fundamental Unit of Life (Cell)
chapters.description: Cell as a basic unit of life; prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, multicellular organisms; cell membrane and cell wall, cell organelles: chloroplast, mitochondria, vacuoles, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus; nucleus, chromosomes - basic structure, number.

levels.title: Cell Structure, Osmosis & Organelles
levels.description: Plasma membrane, osmosis in hypotonic/hypertonic solutions, mitochondria (powerhouse), and plastids.

chapters.title: Tissues
chapters.description: Structure and functions of animal and plant tissues (only four types of tissues in animals; Meristematic and Permanent tissues in plants).

levels.title: Plant & Animal Tissues
levels.description: Meristematic, parenchyma, collenchyma, sclerenchyma, xylem, phloem; epithelial, connective, muscular, and nervous tissues.

units.title: Unit III: Motion, Force and Work

chapters.title: Motion
chapters.description: Distance and displacement, velocity; uniform and non-uniform motion along a straight line; acceleration, distance-time and velocity-time graphs for uniform and uniformly accelerated motion; derivation of equations of motion by graphical method; elementary idea of uniform circular motion.

levels.title: Equations of Motion & Graphical Analysis
levels.description: Deriving v = u + at, s = ut + 1/2*at^2, v^2 = u^2 + 2as using velocity-time graphs.
subtopics: Slope and area of v-t graphs

chapters.title: Force and Newton's Laws
chapters.description: Force and Motion, Newton's Laws of Motion, Action and Reaction forces, Inertia of a body, Inertia and mass, Momentum, Force and Acceleration.

levels.title: Newton's Three Laws of Motion & Momentum
levels.description: First law (Inertia), Second law (F = ma), Third law (action and reaction pairs), and conservation of linear momentum.

chapters.title: Gravitation
chapters.description: Gravitation; Universal Law of Gravitation, Force of Gravitation of the earth (gravity), Acceleration due to Gravity; Mass and Weight; Free fall.

levels.title: Universal Law of Gravitation & Free Fall
levels.description: F = G*m1*m2/d^2, acceleration due to gravity g = GM/R^2, and difference between mass and weight.
subtopics: Calculation of g on Earth and Moon

chapters.title: Work, Energy and Sound
chapters.description: Work done by a Force, Energy, power; Kinetic and Potential energy; Law of conservation of energy. Nature of sound and its propagation in various media, speed of sound, range of hearing in humans; ultrasound; reflection of sound; echo.

levels.title: Work, Kinetic Energy, Potential Energy & Sound
levels.description: Work W = F*s*cos(theta), KE = 1/2*m*v^2, PE = mgh, conservation of mechanical energy; sound waves, echo calculation, ultrasound applications.
subtopics: Work definition and SI unit Joule

chapters.title: Improvement in Food Resources
chapters.description: Plant and animal breeding and selection for quality improvement and management; Use of fertilizers and manures; Protection from pests and diseases; Organic farming.

levels.title: Crop Variety Improvement & Animal Husbandry
levels.description: Nutrient management (manure vs fertilizer), cropping patterns (intercropping, crop rotation), cattle farming, poultry, and apiculture.
